## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you're proposing.

## Problem Solved
Describe the problem this feature would solve or the user need it addresses. For example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe alternatives you've considered, if any.

## Ecosystem Impact
How would this feature benefit the Ethiopian startup ecosystem? Which stakeholders would it impact?

## User Role(s) Affected
- [ ] Ministry Officials

- [ ] Public Users

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
